item.title: Zimbra Collaboration Suite cpio Attachment Path Traversal to Unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2022-41352)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2022-41352. Status: Weaponized (delivers a JSP webshell end to end and can create a global administrator). Affects: Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS), through the amavis content filter and cpio attachment extraction. Tags: zimbra, synacor, amavis, cpio, tar, path-traversal, arbitrary-file-write, jsp-webshell, unauthenticated, cwe-22, kev.
